# VICTO

> VICTO is an AI video ad studio for DTC brands, founded in September 2026 by Reb Howard Victorino in Davao City, Philippines. It makes AI UGC ads, AI commercials, product video ads and video sales letters (VSLs) for skincare, supplement, wellness and pet care brands.

## Services

- Hook Test Pack: one 30-second master ad with 3 hooks (two share a voiceover line with different visuals, one uses a different angle), in 9:16, 4:5 and 16:9, with captions and sound. Delivered 48 hours after an approved brief, with 2 revision rounds and 90-day paid-social usage.
- AI UGC ads, AI product ads, AI VSLs, AI Meta ads, podcast-style and newscast-style ads, claymation and 3D animation ads.
- Platforms: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and YouTube Shorts.
